note: Baseline for the rolling-window test. An all-time aggregate can only GROW. If any count DROPS on a later snapshot, the window is rolling and the medians are current rather than historical - which would unblock every graded figure we withdrew.

cards.name: Mega Gengar ex (Ascended Heroes) — Tyler-corrected Aug 18: chase printing is in AH, not Phantasmal

lastComparison.verdict: NO DROP — consistent with an all-time aggregate (not proof; absence of growth is not absence of a window)

finding.verdict: NO WINDOW. ebaySold is a fixed aggregate that no parameter controls.
evidence: The API rejects period, from, to and window outright and returns allowedParameters; the only time params are days, limitDays and maxDataPoints.

days provably drives priceHistory ONLY: across days=7/90/180 the metadata.historyWindow changed to 7d/90d/180d while the graded aggregate stayed byte-identical (White Kyurem EX psa10 n=40, median $168.50, range 2026-05-27->2026-08-18, totalSales 64).
Per-card dateRangeStart/End spans vary 0-513 days across 309 graded cards, only 13% near 90d, earliest start 2025-03-15 — no fixed rolling window can contain a 513-day span.
Probe re-snapshot after ~4h: 5 of 12 resolved, zero drops. Too short to be decisive; scheduled to repeat.
finding.consequence: Raw ebaySold.medianPrice stays WITHDRAWN — it is a historical average with no statable period.
finding.narrowUnblock: smartMarketPrice DOES carry a window per grade (daysUsed, median 90) plus a confidence. 582 of 2669 grade rows (22%) are medium or high confidence. That is the only defensible graded figure available, and it is a different number from medianPrice.
finding.nextTest: Re-run scripts/graded-window-probe.mjs after 2026-08-30. A DROP in any psa9/psa10 count proves a rolling window and reverses this.
